According to the sources, Aibek Dädebai of the newly-formed Ädilet formed the new government of Kazakhstan after the legislative election on August 23, 2026 [1].

FINAL: Aibek Dädebai of Ädilet formed the new government of Kazakhstan.

hits.text: August 23 – The 2026 Kazakh legislative election was held, with Aibek Dädebai of the newly-formed Ädilet forming the new government of Kazakhstan.
August 23 – 2026 Kazakh legislative election: Pro-Tokayev party Ädilet wins a supermajority in the newly established Kurultai.
The 2026 Kazakh constitutional referendum was held, with nearly 90% of voters in favour.
2026 Kazakh constitutional referendum: The new Constitution of Kazakhstan is accepted with 90% in favor.
Konstantin Tolkachyov, 73, speaker of the State Assembly of the Republic of Bashkortostan (since 1999).
